messages:
Sam (Docs): FYI I opened a small docs PR to update the audit export examples to use pseudonymized tenant identifiers and to clarify retention notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
Priya (Security): thanks. important we don't suggest any reversible mapping. suggest phrase 'tenant identifier (non-reversible pseudonym)'. also call out that full request bodies are omitted when sensitive fields detected.
Jorge (Eng): agree. also the existing Python snippet uses the old export param names. I'll propose a tiny code patch to the snippet so it's copy-paste friendly.
Sam (Docs): can you paste the new py + curl snippets here so I can drop them into the PR?
Jorge (Eng): sure — python:
```python
from redwood.audit import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KEY"))
for row in client.export_rows(scope="tenant", tenant_identifier="nrp-abc123", format="jsonl"):
    print(row)
```
Jorge (Eng): curl example:
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/audit/exports?scope=tenant&tenant_identifier=nrp-abc123" -o tenant-export.jsonl
```
Laila (Legal): wording looks fine. one tiny ask: add sentence 'Exports are subject to configured retention periods unless a legal hold is applied.' keeps SOC2 framing.
Priya (Security): also add a link to the redaction docs: /docs/security/log-redaction and note 'sensitive fields removed or redacted from exported rows'.
Sam (Docs): good points — I'll update the PR text to include: 'tenant identifier (non-reversible pseudonym)'; a short retention sentence from Legal; and a redaction pointer from Security.
DocsBot: docs CI queued for PR #523
Sam (Docs): merging after CI green unless anyone objects. merging in ~45m.
Jorge (Eng): lgtm
Priya (Security): lgtm
Laila (Legal): lgtm
